name: dag-lr-p1
description: G3 (theory-2 6.24, the analyst's pick (a), 11-11 ~09:55): the cell DAG D-L-Nc (chessai-dag-q9: LR leaves, a cluster router over 9 cells pointing to 5 shared leaves, cells re-pointed by fresh scoring at dag-z 2 over 50k-position windows, first check at 1M) x2, against the LR fresh-gate tree T-L-Nc-merge limit 4, 1M (G6's arm, a third seed for seat 2) x2, F-L x2 beside. The factor is the model kind, each with its own gate (the cell DAG takes no --revise; BDD has no fresh gate or probit leaves). Its size is fixed by --dag-leaves and does not grow with data. Prediction: within 20 of the tree at ply 1; read the cell-to-leaf shares at the end (the old D-L-Nc-c sent 98% to one leaf). Training binaries as the recipes give them (dag-q9 for the DAG, hybrid4gfx for the rest: exact, as hybrid6).
